verified_requirements: A record contains descriptive metadata, files, and a persistent identifier.
The deposit form requires a resource type and a license.
Title, publication date, creators, and description are part of the record metadata.
Zenodo registers a DOI when a record is published unless the object already has a DOI.
A DOI may be reserved before publication, but reservation is a real account action.
Published record files and persistent identifiers are immutable; changed files require a new version.
Mixed significant resource types may justify separate records.
A free SSRN user account is required to submit.
The submission needs an English paper title, date written, and English abstract or summary.
Author names, affiliations, and email addresses are required.
Copyright-holder permission is required when applicable.
An uploaded paper must be PDF.
An AI disclosure statement must appear with the abstract and in the PDF when AI was used.
Current guidance lists research written by high-school students and faculty among content types that are typically not accepted.
Rejections receive no individualized reason and are not appealable under the stated policy.
Submissions must be topical, refereeable scientific contributions using accepted scholarly communication.
Only registered authors may submit, and new users or categories may require endorsement.
Submissions are moderated for topical and scientific fit.
Authors are expected to self-submit and must grant a distribution license.
TeX or LaTeX is preferred; PDF is accepted subject to format rules.
Endorsement is not peer review.
Community preprint services use pre-moderation and pending submissions are private until accepted or rejected.
Accepted preprints receive a DOI and persistent URL.
Authors must have sharing rights, disclose conflicts, and remove information that should not be public.
OSF policy says content completely or mostly generated by LLM or AI tools is not appropriate.
OSF policy says organizations should not use user accounts as publication aggregators, clearinghouses, or DOI-minting services.

claim_boundary: This dated snapshot records requirements observed on official repository pages. It is not legal advice, an account action, a submission, a DOI reservation, moderation, acceptance, peer review, or independent replication. Requirements must be rechecked immediately before any owner-authorized submission.
